senses.gloss: --(शैनेयस्): beginning with शिनि and ending with Yugandhara. This is the line of Anamitra, a branch of the वृष्णिस्. (क्षेत्रोपेतद्विजस्). M. ४५. २४; Vi. IV. १४. 4; १९. २३.

--one of the २८ hells, where theft is punished; visited by those who do not fulfill vows undertaken and others who do not perform rituals. भा. V. २६. 7; Br. IV. 2. १४९, १७३-6; वा. १०१. १४८. Vi. II. 6. 5, २८. [page३-529+ २९]

(I)--the king of Sindhu country could not defeat Arjuna supported by कृष्ण;
1: भा. 1. १५. १६.
killed Abhimanyu during the कुरुक्षेत्र war but was slain by Arjuna; see Jayadratha.
2: Ib. X. ७८ [९५ (v) ३०], ३५.
(II)--the horse of the Sind on which Sud- yumna rode to the northern forests. भा. IX. 1. २३.
(III)--(च्) a kingdom watered by the Sin- dhu; noted for horses. Br. II. १८. ४८; IV. १७. २७; M. १२१. ४७.
(IV)--a disciple of शौनक; again divided the सम्हिता into two parts and gave to मुञ्जकेश. वा. ४७. ४६; ६१. ५३; Vi. III. 6. १२.

--were enlisted by जरासन्ध against the Yadus;
1: भा. X. [५० (v) 3].
country of the.
2: Vi. II. 3. १७.
--read अथर्व सम्हिता with Babhru from शुनेक; a pupil of शौनक. भा. XII. 7. 3; Br. II. ३५. ६०.

--a कौशिक clan;
1: Br. III. ६६. ७४.
त्रयार्षेय.
2: M. १९८. 4.
--an army of four-fold forces and of six limbs; a nuisance to peace. Br. III. २६. ५२-3; २७. १२-13; ३८. १८; ४८. 7. [page३-693+ २६]
